notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content: Small patch to clean up some minor bugs

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
Added additional game optimization
Fixed all key issues
Adjusted ammo and health items for better balance
Adjusted visual effects 
Fixed an issue that was causing player shadows to obscure player vision in certain lighting
Added an interactive item to acquire additional storage space
Adjusted enemy ragdoll physics
Fixed enemy damage issues on certain enemies
Adjusted collision detection
Various minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Released
notes.content:
Fixes unobtainable key in the morgue
Butcher enemy now takes correct damage
Path out of the large cave, after defeating the mini boss, is now more clearly marked

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3a Released
notes.content: Fixes bug in Lost that prevented some enemies from taking appropriate damage.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Released
notes.content:
Entering inventory now pauses the game. No more deaths while healing
Enemy AI improvements
Game optimization improvements
Some minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.b Released
notes.content: Minor tweaks to improve all around experience

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Released
notes.content:
Further improvement of enemies
Key mismatch fixed in The Facility which was halting progress
Fixed glitch in Lost for avoiding Tuck fight
Various minor bugs fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 Released: 
Improved enemy hit boxes.
Key naming improved. You can now examine any key to see its exact use. 
Music volume adjusted. 
Fixed issue with final Lost enemy not respawning after player death. 
Various other minor bug fixes.
